messages:
Maya (Docs): Quick note: while updating the v1->v2 migration guide I discovered an embed alias swap that changed vector size (1024 -> 1536). We should add a short warning and a tiny migration recipe.
Lee (SDK): Can you paste the minimal repro (truncated)? We'll add a dim-check snippet.
Maya (Docs): Truncated example: `POST /v2/embeddings body:{"model":"alias:embed-new","input":"hello"} response:{"data":[{"embedding":[...1536 floats...]}]}`
Rahul (Product): Product asks for two things: 1) banner in migration docs, 2) checklist: sample test, compare dims, reindex or pin version.
Lee (SDK): Proposed snippet for docs: `resp = client.embeddings.create(...); dim = len(resp.data[0].embedding); if dim != expected_dim: raise RuntimeError("embedding size mismatch; pin model or reindex")` We'll add examples for Python/JS/Go.
Tess (Infra): I'll add `vector_dim` to model catalog API so docs/SDK can show dims. Filing INF-901.
docs-bot: created task DOCS-1402 embed-dim-warning assigned to @Maya, @Lee, @Tess due in 10 days.
Maya (Docs): I'll open a docs PR with the banner, migration subsection "Embedding dimensionality changes", FAQ bullet, and the truncated example. Will avoid full vectors.
Lee (SDK): I'll open SDK PR referencing the docs PR and include unit tests for friendly error messages.
Rahul (Product): Approve wording once PRs are up. Also add an FAQ entry: "What if my index breaks when dims change?" with steps.
Maya (Docs): Thanks team. I'll ping reviewers on the PR when ready. :white_check_mark:
